alt.en: An arXiv preprint reports gaps between agents’ completion claims and recorded checks, and proposes a structured ledger. Its abstract also flags a local mutation surface in a specific Agenttrail commit.
alt.zh: 一篇 arXiv 预印本报告了智能体完成声明与检查记录之间的缺口，并提出结构化账本方案。摘要还指出，Agenttrail 的一个特定提交存在未经身份验证的本地修改接口。
